[[Totem of An'she]] | previous = [[Mycellakos (quest)|Mycellakos]] }} == Objectives == Bring the Core of Mycellakos to Magatha Grimtotem in The Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff. * [[Heart of Mycellakos]] == Description == Purifying this core is well beyond my abilities. As much as I hate to admit it, there is no way I can do this alone. It is with a heavy heart that I part with this core; I wished for nothing more than to research it and uncover what caused it to become alive. Nevertheless, this is knowledge that must be passed on. There is someone who will surely know how to handle the core—our Matron. You will find her in Thunder Bluff, at the Elder Rise. Pay no mind to Cor and Grom; I will give you my mark, and you will be able to walk freely past them. Do not speak too much before the Matron. She has a short fuse, and—believe it or not—I have grown fond of you. ==Rewards== You may choose one of: * [[Left]] * [[Right]] * [[Totem of An'she]] You will also receive: * 2000 XP == Progress == Speak. == Completion == Uda'pe was right to send you to me. Though we are not very fond of working with the Horde, you have my thanks and will be paid accordingly. I will even add a bonus for being so silent and respectful—Uda'pe taught you well. ==Progression== #{{questlong|Horde|33|Living Fungus}} #{{questlong|Horde|33D|Mycellakos (quest)|Mycellakos}} #{{questlong|Horde|35|The Matron Will Know}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}
